title: Cutting a stretch out of a recording takes its captions along
goal: When you cut a piece out of a talking recording and the gap closes, the captions stay where they were, so every line after the cut is shown over the wrong words and lines for speech you threw away still play over black or over the next clip. Cutting should take the captions (and the titles and sounds after it) along with the picture, the way a Premiere editor with sync lock on expects.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-24 with Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/an-editing-session-walk.json --no-build (screen unlocked, real captures): openSampleTalk (17.25s, 10 captions), Command K at 8.63s and 4.31s, Delete. V1 becomes two pieces ending at 12.94s, but the Captions track still runs to 17.25s: see /tmp/photonz-playtest/an-editing-session-walk/2-cut-sc.png and 3-second-clip-sc.png, and playing-19.png / playing-20.png where the cue 'layer that happens to have a start and an' plays over the b-roll. Cause: EditorState.deleteClipPieceInHand calls PhotonzDocument.removeClipPiece, which edits only that clip's ClipPieces (ClipPieces.swift editClip); nothing else in the document moves. rippleTime(atMS:byMS:exceptLayer:) in HoldPush.swift already moves every other layer for a hold that pushes everything and can shorten a straddling layer; it does not yet drop a layer wholly inside a removed stretch. Captions are text layers with their own LayerTime inside the Captions group (Captions.swift CaptionLayers.layers), so moving them is ordinary layer time. Decide with the user only if a Premiere-style per-track sync lock is wanted; the default behaviour should be ripple everything.
acceptance: Deleting a piece of a clip removes the captions that sat only inside it and moves every later caption earlier by the length removed
A caption that straddles the removed stretch is shortened, never left running over the join
Titles and sounds that start after the removed stretch move earlier with it, and one undo puts everything back
an-editing-session-walk claims the last caption ends with the recording after its cut, and passes
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: digest 2026-09-24: reproduced. Ran Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/an-editing-session-walk.json --no-build (status ok). log.json after the cut and b-roll: 'Sample Talk on V1 0.00s to 12.94s; b-roll on V1 12.94s to 20.94s', and 3-second-clip-sc.png shows the caption cues running on to about 17 s, over the b-roll. Stays p1, and now runs just before the Extract task, whose acceptance needs captions to follow a removed stretch.

Adversarial pass before building: a Premiere editor with sync lock on expects a ripple of the piece to take every track along; the cut mock (video-cut-wt) says a detached voiceover under the cut 'has not moved a frame', so a sound across the whole stretch is left alone while words and shapes across it are shortened. Caption words carry document-clock timings (captionWords), so they are squeezed by the same rule or the lit word would drift.

Built: PhotonzDocument.removeTime(fromMS:toMS:exceptLayer:) (Sources/PhotonzCore/StretchRemoval.swift, 11 tests in StretchRemovalTests). rippleDeleteClipPiece uses it instead of closeGap, and Delete on a piece (deleteClipPieceInHand) now calls rippleDeleteClipPiece, so Delete and the Delete/Ripple Delete menu rows all take the stretch out of the whole document in one undo step. New walk action captionsExpectEndWithRecording; an-editing-session-walk runs it after the cut: 'the last one ends at 12.94s, the recording at 12.94s' (was 17.25s), status ok, playing-20.png over the b-roll has no caption. One-off /tmp walk cut, undo, redo: 10 cues/17.25s -> 8 cues/12.94s -> Command Z -> 10 cues/17.25s -> redo -> 8/12.94s.

Left rough, none filed (all intended or the user's call via the audit): a caption across the join keeps its full text, only shorter (Premiere trims the caption clip the same way); a speech sound across the whole cut stays put and so is out of step after the join, as the cut mock chooses for a detached voiceover; nothing shows which tracks a delete moves (the cut mock's own open question, no per-track sync lock yet); Delete and Ripple Delete on a piece now do the same thing. Full Scripts/test.sh green (9561) on the third run; the two failures before it were export-size flakes folded into the-export-size-test-fails-about-one-run-in-thre.

Delete on a piece of a clip now takes the same stretch out of the whole document (PhotonzDocument.removeTime in Sources/PhotonzCore/StretchRemoval.swift, used by rippleDeleteClipPiece and Delete): captions only inside the piece go, later captions/titles/sounds move up with their words, captions across the join are shortened, one undo restores. Verified: 11 new core tests, full Scripts/test.sh green, an-editing-session-walk ok with new captionsExpectEndWithRecording step (last caption 12.94s = recording, was 17.25s), cut/undo/redo one-off walk.
